copy_gaps: the grace announcement's words: §4 L185 gives its region and timing (polite at 60 s and 10 s, D06:58) but no §14 key gives its text and D02:688 defers to E09-D06 §6, which gives none: not drawn, annotated as a gap
'Users': an anatomy string, not a §14 key (spec L294)
'+ Invite user': an anatomy string, not a §14 key (spec L294)
'Admin': an anatomy string, not a §14 key (spec L188)
live_checks: grace line: its two text nodes ('Still trusted for user changes ·' in type.ui.body, '2:14' in type.num.base) sit on one line at the band's right end, space.inset.xs apart for the word space; check the baselines after relayout
route-content placeholder: vs=fill takes <main>'s remaining height (estimated 480 px at 1280, 1120 px at 2560); check the footer marker sits at the column's foot, unclipped
annotation column: about 1385 px of the 1440 px inside the root (clip on); after touchTexts and relayout check its footer line is not clipped (raise the root's h if it is)
glyph ◆ (U+25C6): confirm Inter draws it; else Penpot substitutes a fallback font
root name: after the first section call the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name, or later calls create a duplicate root
deviations: Board choice: SH-5 (§4 L185) names no page, so the band reads the route of §4 L166 (Users), the PageHeader is SCR-121's (§7 L294: 'Users', '+ Invite user', meta.asof) and the route content, CMP-087's children, is one neutral color.surface.canvas placeholder with no text: SCR-121's own states are boards 30-41 and 95, and §1 gives no last sign-in or display name for its rows.

Board choice: the strip is empty and reads strip.none on one line (§4 L168), as OV-2 does on the same data (L275): §1's worked example raises no strip item (users.without_mfa 0, tier recorded, no key, tamper, drift, withdrawal or break-glass fact); SH-5 adds none (no 'Unlock again' item: no countdown elsewhere).
A live countdown (band badge, grace line, view-as banner) sets its clock in type.num.base as its own text node (D02:120; Appendix A L865 CMP-087 Tokens); the node's note carries the full §14 string.

Buttons, chips, badges, banners, fields, tiles, tables, menus and dialogs are compositions from tokens: admin controls are 32 px (size.control.comfortable, §4 L176) while the library CMP-001 binds size.control.height (24 px in the file's compact density), and cvsheet v1 cannot set an instance's glyph, fill or border.

TopBar, NavRail, RightRail and StatusBar content other than the Admin entry, the env badges and the owner's name is drawn as neutral placeholders (E10-D02 owns it; §1 L97 gives only the sizes); the chrome binds color.surface.app with color.border.subtle dividers (no source names a chrome surface).
Board names carry Penpot's normalised ' / ' form (E42-D03 / 31 SCR-121 / populated · …) so cvsheet's find-or-create root matches on every section call; §0 L46-47 writes 'SCR-121/populated'.
